name: PO Delivered SO yet to deliver
query:
SELECT
    so.name AS "Sales Order:Link/Sales Order:150",
    so.transaction_date AS "SO Date:Date",
    so.status AS "SO Status:Data",
    so.customer AS "Customer:Link/Customer:150",
    pr.name AS "Purchase Receipt:Link/Purchase Receipt:150",
    pr.posting_date AS "Receipt Date:Date",
    pr.status AS "Receipt Status:Data"
FROM
    `tabSales Order` so
INNER JOIN
    `tabPurchase Receipt Item` pri ON pri.sales_order = so.name
INNER JOIN
    `tabPurchase Receipt` pr ON pr.name = pri.parent
WHERE
    so.status = 'To Deliver and Bill'
    AND pr.status IN ('Completed', 'To Bill')
    AND pr.docstatus = 1;
report_name: PO Delivered SO yet to deliver
